dc0637bd62611784.title: Androgen signaling via sympathetic neurons regulates allergic pulmonary inflammation.
digest: Sex differences in the rates of asthma onset and remission suggest that sex hormones may play an important role in the pathogenic mechanism underlying certain forms of asthma.
Here, we demonstrate that increased endogenous androgen production in male mice can mitigate pulmonary type 2 inflammation after repeated allergen exposures during early life.
Thus, an endocrine-neuroimmune axis contributes to the sexual dimorphism of allergic asthma during development.

17dd5ca081b07af4.title: Maternal cell-free RNA versus combined screening for first-trimester prediction of early-onset preeclampsia: a nested case-control study
digest: First-trimester MaiRa and FMF risk estimates were evaluated in the same 126 pregnant women, comprising 99 uncomplicated controls and 27 EOPE cases, defined by disease onset before 34 weeks.
Universal and contingent MaiRa implementation strategies were also evaluated.

MaiRa showed greater first-trimester discrimination for EOPE than FMF combined screening (AUC, 0.974 vs 0.900; P=.040) and consistently achieved higher detection rates across fixed false-positive rates.

evidence.quote: At false-positive rates of 5% and 10%, MaiRa detected 85.2% and 92.6% of EOPE cases, compared with 44.4% and 70.4% for FMF, respectively.

5e7e8731c48d0661.title: Tracing the origins of de novo coronary collateral formation in cardiac repair.
digest: Coronary collateral arteries have been proposed to form de novo through artery reassembly, a process in which arterial endothelial cells (ECs) migrate away from preexisting arteries and reassemble into new arteries.
Using genetic tools that trace arterial ECs, we found that their contribution to collaterals is modest.
In addition, transient Vegfa expression through modified messenger RNA markedly promoted collateral formation.

evidence.quote: Mechanistically, vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) drives arterialization by regulating HES1 transcription through YY1/SETD1A-mediated H3K4 trimethylation.

38fb4d071b87cea5.title: Mitochondrial DNA leakage in oocytes activates cGAS-STING signaling to drive ovarian aging
digest: The cGAS-STING signaling pathway contributes to low-grade inflammation in several tissues during aging; however, its role in the ovary was unclear.

Here the authors show that aging oocytes leak mitochondrial DNA into the cytosol where it activates the cGAS-STING pathway, driving inflammatory signaling in oocytes as well as neighboring granulosa cells via cGAMP transfer.
Inhibiting this pathway ameliorates ovarian aging.
